forward_path: Regenerate the JSON and markdown baselines before any contract change and diff them in review.
Allocate new wire profile ids or schema generations instead of editing deployed meanings in place.
Document transport, Redis, or manifest layout changes beside the code that changes them.
compatibility.guarantee: This freeze adds read-only tooling and versioned baseline artifacts only; it does not change wire formats, firmware behavior, MQTT topics, Redis keys, or manifests.
rollback_path: Revert the contract-changing commit or restore the earlier versioned baseline files.
Redeploy the prior firmware tag or manifest set if an operational change shipped with the contract change.
Run `python3 tools/freeze_contracts.py --check` to confirm the checkout matches the frozen baseline again.

corpus_fixture_metadata.privacy_note: Representative fixture inventory only: repo paths, top-level schema ids, counts, sizes, and sha256 digests. No live corpus pulls and no payload bodies are copied.
